scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:run-android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
